reports.title: Plan budgétaire (Budget du Québec)
reports.publisher: Ministère des Finances du Québec
reports.description: The annual multi-year Budget Plan of the Government of Quebec, presenting the fiscal framework, revenues (own-source and federal transfers), portfolio expenditures, debt service, accounting balance, Balanced Budget Act balance after Generations Fund deposits, economic outlook assumptions, and new measures. Tabled with the budget speech, typically in mid-March for the fiscal year beginning 1 April.

reports.title: Le point sur la situation économique et financière du Québec
reports.publisher: Ministère des Finances du Québec
reports.description: In-year update of Quebec's economic and financial situation, revising revenue, expenditure and deficit forecasts against the tabled Plan budgétaire, and updating the multi-year framework. Typically released in the fall (e.g., November).

reports.title: Bilan démographique du Québec
reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
reports.description: Annual comprehensive demographic report for Quebec covering population estimates and change, natural increase (births and deaths), international and interprovincial migration, age structure, fertility and mortality. Draws on vital statistics and collaborates with Statistics Canada population estimates.

reports.title: Décret de population des municipalités
reports.publisher: Gouvernement du Québec (Conseil des ministres / Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation)
reports.description: Annual order-in-council establishing the official population of every local municipality, northern village and borough for the application of laws, regulations and government programs. Explicitly based on estimates produced by the Institut de la statistique du Québec as of 1 July of the prior year.
reports.cadence_note: annual (late December for the following calendar year)

reports.title: Rapport financier consolidé (états financiers audités) de la Ville de Montréal
reports.publisher: Ville de Montréal
reports.description: Annual audited consolidated financial statements and financial accountability report of the City of Montreal, presenting operating results for tax purposes, surplus/deficit by local and agglomeration responsibilities, capital investments, debt ratios and other disclosures under Public Sector Accounting Standards.
reports.cadence_note: annual (typically June for the prior calendar year)

reports.title: Budget de fonctionnement de la Ville de Québec
reports.publisher: Ville de Québec
reports.description: Annual balanced operating budget of the City of Quebec, presenting revenues (taxes and compensations in lieu, transfers, services rendered, imposition of rights), expenditures, investment budget, and tax-rate decisions for the fiscal year, with reconciliation to Public Sector Accounting Standards.

reports.title: Rapports financiers des organismes municipaux (sommation et base de données)
reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
reports.description: Annual compilation and public release of the audited financial reports and complementary information submitted by all local municipalities, RCMs, metropolitan communities, intermunicipal boards and public transit bodies in Quebec. Includes aggregate summations by organism type and open-data extracts used for provincial monitoring and fiscal analysis.

reports.title: Manuel de la présentation de l'information financière municipale
reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
reports.description: Authoritative provincial manual prescribing the form, content and accounting treatments for municipal financial reports and fiscal-purpose reconciliations in Quebec. Aligns presentation with Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards while incorporating Quebec-specific legislative requirements for taxation and debt.

reports.title: Richesse foncière uniformisée (RFU) des municipalités
reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
reports.description: Annual provincial dataset and complementary guide measuring each municipality's equalized assessment (richesse foncière uniformisée). Computed from the values on the municipal real-estate assessment roll multiplied by the comparative factor for that roll, plus selected non-taxable values. Serves as the fiscal-capacity measure for municipal equalization, intermunicipal cost-sharing and metropolitan community allocations.

reports.title: Manuel d'évaluation foncière du Québec (MEFQ)
reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
reports.description: Official provincial manual that prescribes the methodology, data standards, valuation techniques and legal requirements for preparing and maintaining municipal real-estate assessment rolls (rôles d'évaluation foncière). Updated periodically; the edition in force governs all rolls coming into force in a given year. Provides the uniform basis from which the richesse foncière uniformisée is derived.
reports.cadence_note: updated as needed (annual editions for successive roll years)

reports.title: Produit intérieur brut réel par industrie au Québec
reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
reports.description: Monthly estimates of real GDP by industry for Quebec as a whole (seasonally adjusted, annualized, basic prices). Produced using the net-production method preferred under national-accounts conventions, with indicator methods where necessary. Released approximately 2.5 months after the reference month.

reports.title: Produit intérieur brut régional par industrie au Québec
reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
reports.description: Annual estimates of GDP by industry for Quebec's 17 administrative regions and selected census metropolitan areas, in current dollars at basic prices. Derived by allocating provincial industry totals (from the Comptes économiques) using fiscal and census-based allocators.

reports.title: Taux de taxes de la Ville de Montréal
reports.publisher: Ville de Montréal
reports.description: Annual schedule of property-tax rates (taxe foncière générale, water, road, ARTM contribution, borough service taxes, etc.) adopted by the City of Montreal for the fiscal year. Rates vary by property category, value bracket and borough; applied to the values on the current triennial assessment roll after any phasing measures.

reports.title: Loi sur l'équilibre budgétaire
reports.publisher: Assemblée nationale du Québec / Éditeur officiel du Québec
reports.description: Provincial statute that defines the budgetary balance for the purposes of the Balanced Budget Act, excludes Generations Fund transactions from the balance, and requires a multi-year return-to-balance plan when a deficit is recorded. The Plan budgétaire presents both the accounting balance and the balance 'within the meaning of the Balanced Budget Act'.

reports.title: Rôles d'évaluation foncière de l'agglomération de Montréal (triennal)
reports.publisher: Ville de Montréal (Direction de l'évaluation foncière)
reports.description: Triennial real-estate assessment rolls for the 16 municipalities of the Montreal agglomeration. Deposited every three years (most recent 2026-2027-2028 deposited September 2025), they inventory every immovable, its characteristics and its real value as of the statutory valuation date (1 July of the year preceding the first year of the roll). Form the legal base for municipal and school property taxes and for the calculation of richesse foncière uniformisée.

reports.title: Règlement sur l'imposition des taxes et des compensations (Ville de Québec)
reports.publisher: Ville de Québec
reports.description: Annual by-law (most recent R.V.Q. 3492 for fiscal year 2026) that sets the general property-tax rates by property category, water/sewer and residual-materials tariffs, and other compensations for the City of Quebec. Applied to the values on the current assessment roll.

reports.title: Fonds des générations (revenus consacrés et solde)
reports.publisher: Ministère des Finances du Québec
reports.description: Statutory dedicated fund whose revenues (water-power royalties, additional Hydro-Québec contribution, investment income, and occasional transfers from other funds) are used exclusively for debt repayment. The annual dedicated revenues and fund balance are reported in the Plan budgétaire and are excluded from the budgetary balance under the Loi sur l'équilibre budgétaire.

reports.title: Projections démographiques du Québec et de ses régions
reports.publisher: Institut de la statistique du Québec
reports.description: Annual update of population projections for Quebec and its administrative regions (and selected CMAs) under multiple scenarios. Incorporates the latest fertility, mortality and migration assumptions; used for medium- and long-term planning and as context for the Bilan démographique and economic forecasts.

reports.title: Proportions médianes des rôles et facteurs comparatifs
reports.publisher: Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation
reports.description: Annual publication of the median proportion of each municipal assessment roll relative to market and the resulting comparative factors used to uniformize assessed values for the calculation of richesse foncière uniformisée and other fiscal applications.

reports.title: Règlement sur la proportion médiane du rôle d'évaluation foncière
reports.publisher: Gouvernement du Québec (Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation)
reports.description: Provincial regulation that prescribes the exact statistical method for calculating the median proportion of each municipal assessment roll relative to market sales, and the corresponding comparative factor. The resulting factors are approved by the Minister and used to uniformize values for RFU and other fiscal applications.

dependencies.basis: Volet I of the TVQ growth-sharing formula allocates the bulk of the envelope on the basis of the official population of each municipality as established in the annual Décret de population. The document states: "Une première répartition s’effectue sur la base de la population inscrite au Décret de population et de l’ indice de vitalité économique (IVÉ) de la municipalité."

By statute the Décret de population must be established on the basis of the population estimates produced by the Institut de la statistique du Québec; the Bilan démographique and related ISQ demographic products are the public expression of those estimates. The document states: "Le dénombrement est basé sur des estimations faites par l' Institut de la statistique du Québec en date du 1 er juillet 2025."

ISQ population estimates that feed the Décret are produced in collaboration with Statistics Canada and rest on the adjusted census counts and intercensal estimates published by StatCan. The document states: "Les estimations de la population sont produites par Statistique Canada, avec la collaboration de l’Institut de la statistique du Québec (ISQ) et de plusieurs ministères et organismes. Elles ont comme base les comptes de population des recensements"

Municipal financial statements in Quebec, including Montreal's audited consolidated report, are prepared in accordance with the Canadian Public Sector Accounting Standards (Normes comptables pour le secteur public). The document states: "Les organismes municipaux préparent leurs documents financiers en s’appuyant sur les Normes comptables pour le secteur public telles qu’elles sont établies par le Conseil sur la comptabilité dans le secteur public de CPA Canada."

The form, content, fiscal-purpose reconciliations and required schedules of every municipal financial report submitted to and compiled by MAMH are prescribed by the Manuel de la présentation de l'information financière municipale. The document states: "Le Manuel a pour but de fournir aux administrateurs municipaux et à toutes les personnes actives dans le domaine municipal les éléments de base pour assurer une présentation adéquate et uniforme de l'information financière. ... Il respecte également la présentation de l’information financière selon les formulaires prescrits par le gouvernement, notamment le rapport financier"

Federal equalization payments form a material component of Quebec's total revenues in the multi-year financial framework presented in the Plan budgétaire; the budget tables and narrative report the amounts received under the federal program. The document states: "Transferts fédéraux 30 577 ... Sources: Institut de la statistique du Québec, Statistics Canada and Ministère des Finances du Québec."

The economic outlook and nominal/real GDP forecasts underlying the revenue projections in the Plan budgétaire rely on Statistics Canada provincial economic accounts and related national-accounts data, as explicitly sourced in the budget documents. The document states: "Sources: Institut de la statistique du Québec, Statistics Canada and Ministère des Finances du Québec."

ISQ demographic estimates and the Bilan démographique are anchored on the adjusted census counts from Statistics Canada's Census of Population. The document states: "Elles ont comme base les comptes de population des recensements, mais ont pour objectifs : 1) de corriger les résultats des recensements afin de tenir compte du sous-dénombrement net et des réserves partiellement dénombrées"

The population levels, components of growth and intercensal estimates published in the Bilan démographique are produced jointly with, and rest on, Statistics Canada's population estimates program. The document states: "Les estimations de la population sont produites par Statistique Canada, avec la collaboration de l’Institut de la statistique du Québec (ISQ)"

Municipal equalization eligibility and payment amounts under the Règlement sur le régime de péréquation are determined by comparing each municipality's richesse foncière uniformisée per capita (and average housing value) to provincial medians; the RFU dataset is the direct source of those figures. The document states: "Elle sert aussi de base de répartition d’une partie du programme de péréquation municipale."

The values that enter the RFU calculation are the values inscribed on the municipal assessment roll; those rolls are prepared and maintained strictly according to the methodology, data standards and valuation techniques prescribed by the Manuel d'évaluation foncière du Québec. The document states: "Les évaluations sont uniformisées en les multipliant par le facteur comparatif approuvé par la ou le ministre des Affaires municipales pour l’année en cours. ... Comme les rôles triennaux des municipalités ne sont pas tous déposés la même année..."

The monthly real GDP-by-industry series is compiled according to the production approach and concepts of the System of National Accounts (basic-price valuation, net production method preferred). The document states: "Mesure l'activité économique générée par un secteur ou une industrie. Il estime, en dollars constants, la contribution du secteur ou de l'industrie à la production. Pour produire ces estimations, la méthode dite de la production nette est l'approche privilégiée."

The Plan budgétaire presents both an accounting balance and a distinct 'budgetary balance within the meaning of the Balanced Budget Act' that excludes Generations Fund deposits; the Act itself defines that balance and the required return-to-balance plan. The document states: "Le solde budgétaire pour une année financière est formé de l’écart entre les revenus et les dépenses établis conformément aux conventions comptables du gouvernement. Il ne comprend pas: 1 ° les revenus et les dépenses comptabilisés au Fonds des générations"

Regional allocation of industry value-added uses commuting matrices and place-of-work data derived from Statistics Canada census (and National Household Survey) special tabulations. The document states: "elles sont transformées en données selon le lieu de travail au moyen des tableaux de navettage résidence-travail par industrie (SCIAN). Ces matrices sont construites à l’aide de compilations spéciales de Statistique Canada faites à partir des données de l’Enquête nationale auprès des ménages (ENM) de 2011 ... et du recensement de 2016"

Property-tax rates published for a given year are applied to the assessed values appearing on the current triennial assessment roll (after any statutory phasing of value changes). The document states: "Le rôle d’évaluation sert de base au calcul des taxes municipales et scolaires."

The RFU for Montreal-area municipalities is computed directly from the values inscribed on the agglomeration's triennial assessment rolls, multiplied by the applicable comparative factor. The document states: "La RFU d’une municipalité comprend l’évaluation uniformisée de tous les immeubles imposables situés sur son territoire... Les évaluations sont uniformisées en les multipliant par le facteur comparatif"

The annual tax-and-compensation by-law implements the taxation decisions contained in the City's adopted operating budget for that fiscal year. The document states: "Ce règlement prévoit l’imposition des taxes et des compensations pour l’exercice financier de 2026."

The Balanced Budget Act explicitly excludes revenues and expenditures recorded in the Generations Fund from the statutory budgetary balance and requires the Fund's dedicated revenues to be used solely for debt reduction. The document states: "Il ne comprend pas: 1 ° les revenus et les dépenses comptabilisés au Fonds des générations institué par la Loi sur la réduction de la dette et instituant le Fonds des générations"

One of the three components of the Indice de vitalité économique is the five-year average annual population growth rate (TAAM), which is taken from the official population estimates underlying the Bilan démographique and related ISQ demographic products. The document states: "Sources : Institut de la statistique du Québec, exploitation des données fiscales des particuliers de Revenu Québec et Estimations démographiques annuelles."

The five-year population growth component (TAAM) of the IVE is calculated from the official annual population estimates produced by Statistics Canada in collaboration with ISQ. The document states: "Statistique Canada, Estimations démographiques annuelles (régions infraprovinciales, mai 2024)."

Uniformization of assessed values for RFU purposes is performed by multiplying the values on each municipal roll by the comparative factor derived from that roll's median proportion relative to market. The document states: "Les évaluations sont uniformisées en les multipliant par le facteur comparatif approuvé par la ou le ministre des Affaires municipales pour l’année en cours."

The annual population-projection update incorporates the latest observed fertility, mortality and migration components published in the Bilan démographique and related demographic estimates. The document states: "The new projections take into account the most recent data on migration, fertility and mortality."

The annual calculation and approval of each roll's median proportion and comparative factor are governed by the specific statistical rules set out in the Règlement sur la proportion médiane du rôle d'évaluation foncière. The document states: "Le Règlement sur la proportion médiane du rôle d’évaluation foncière prescrit la façon d’établir la proportion médiane de chacun des rôles d’évaluation."

The Manuel d'évaluation foncière du Québec incorporates and operationalizes the statutory method for establishing the median proportion, directing assessors to the regulation's rules. The document states: "La proportion médiane du rôle est constituée par la donnée médiane des ratios individuels conservés à la suite de deux épurations successives"
